claim: bpf_movein() in sys/net/bpf.c lacks an explicit assertion on hlen before bcopy to sockp->sa_data, leaving the BPF/ifnet contract implicit rather than machine-checkable.
confirmation_criteria: MPASS(hlen <= sizeof(sockp->sa_data)) merged into FreeBSD src and present in a release
Assertion verifiable in FreeBSD src commit history
falsification_criteria: Original attribution was falsified by independent review showing reproducer violated DLT_NULL contract
Corrected reproducer injects packet successfully on lo0

evidence.description: Source showing hlen used in bcopy without explicit bounds assertion
Original reproducer without DLT_NULL header returned EAFNOSUPPORT
Corrected reproducer with AF_INET in host byte order wrote 24 bytes successfully

trace.description: BPF write(2) interface on lo0 — DLT_NULL type
BPF/ifnet contract boundary — hlen consumed without explicit assertion
Attribution falsified — reproducer corrected — validation confirmed on FreeBSD 14.5-RELEASE

refutation.criterion: Reproducer must satisfy DLT_NULL contract — 32-bit AF header required
refutation.observed_result: Original reproducer violated DLT_NULL contract — EAFNOSUPPORT was reproducer error, not kernel bug
refutation.reason: Independent review by glebius (FreeBSD committer) established that pkt[] was missing the required 32-bit address-family header for DLT_NULL. Corrected reproducer confirmed by local verification on FreeBSD 14.5-RELEASE.
